text: The Nile River flows northward through northeastern Africa before reaching the Mediterranean Sea.
Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure at sea level.
The Great Wall of China was built over many centuries by successive dynasties.
Photosynthesis in plants converts light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose molecules.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level on the Earth.
The Amazon rainforest covers much of the Amazon basin in South America.
Sound travels faster through water than it does through air under normal conditions.
The Roman Empire expanded across Europe, North Africa, and the Middle East over several centuries.
A solar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes between the Sun and the Earth.
The human heart pumps blood through a network of arteries, veins, and capillaries.
The printing press, developed in the fifteenth century, greatly increased the spread of books.
Antarctica is the coldest continent and contains most of the world's fresh water.
Tides are caused mainly by the gravitational pull of the Moon on Earth's oceans.
The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, located in northern Africa.
Bread is typically made by mixing flour, water, yeast, and salt, then baking the dough.
The city of Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the most populous metropolitan areas.
Glaciers form when snow accumulates over many years and compresses into dense ice.
The Danube is the second-longest river in Europe and flows through ten countries.
Electrical current flows through a circuit when there is a closed path and a voltage source.
Earthquakes result from the sudden release of energy along faults in the Earth's crust.

جبل إيفرست هو أعلى جبل فوق مستوى سطح البحر على كوكب الأرض.
